core_obligations: Separate T from the failure locus by constructible closed sets in the spectral space
Blow up to disjoint the closures, then isomorphify over Y_0 by the Zariski-after-blowup lemma
Extend the local blowup globally by the admissible-blowup extension lemma

difficulty_reason: Separate T from the non-isomorphism locus T' by constructible closed supersets in the spectral space |V| (quasi-compact open W containing T' and missing T, etc.), separate their closures by lemma-separate-disjoint-locally-closed-by-blowing-up; on the open Y_0 = Y \ closure(T'_c) the morphism is already an isomorphism, so the Zariski-after-blowup lemma gives a V_0-admissible blowup Y'_0 with X'_0 ≅ Y'_0, and the extend-admissible-blowups lemma glues it to a global V-admissible blowup whose strict transform restricts to that isomorphism.
